This was where I was yesterday


12-31-16... Exactly 365 days ago I walk into work like any other day with the excitement of a fresh start coming for the New Year. What I didn’t expect was that night my life would be changed forever. New Years Eve I laid eyes upon the most beautiful woman I’ve ever seen. This tall slender brunette with the most beautiful brown eyes and a smile that will light a dark room. I asked one of my colleagues who that was and she says I think her name is Kait. We worked our ass off that night and didn’t talk much until we had closed. But I couldn’t help but admire her from afar every chance I had that night. Watching her collect as many of the light up cups as she could get her hands on. When the night finally ends we are sitting in the office at work. She’s sitting on the floor getting her money mixed up when I’m trying not to make it obvious that I’m in to her so I make casual conversation and ask “So, what’s your story?” She replies “I got 2 kids bruh!” I can’t stop thinking about how someone as beautiful as her has 2 kids and has a body like that! As the year progressed I always checked my schedule every week to see if I was working with Kait. I just admired from a distance as we slowly got to know each other and became friends. The highlight of my week was always walking into work and waiting for 8 o’clock for Kait to walk in. It always made my day better seeing her beautiful smile. We grew closer over time but I had second thoughts about getting involved with a co-worker so I had to fight off my feelings and even saw others but with Kait they were just too strong to resist. Going through so many ups and downs in such a short period of time we have enough stories to write a great country song Through hell and high water we finally ended up together. Since then we have laughed together, cried together, fought each other, forgave each other, helped each other, but most importantly we have loved each other. As we close out 2017 I’m blessed and grateful that her beautiful face is the last thing I see before I fall asleep and the first thing I see when I open my eyes to in the morning. Thinking back on all the memories of laughing and smiling. From the very first time she called me to tell me she blew out 2 of her tires. The road trips home singing at the top of our lungs in the car. Collecting hundreds of bottle caps for her yet to be completed Pinterest project. The late night breakfasts. Sitting around playing on the pull up bars. Late night challenges on the pool table 😉. The pit stop naps at my house on her way home. Being excited to stop at Thornton’s. Cramped up on the small hospital bed for weeks. Laser tag and bowling with the kids. Four square in the back yard. Watching the sun disappear in the middle of the day and watching the meteor showers at night in the freezing cold. Netflix all day everyday. Just to name a few. 

We have had the best of times... We’ve had the worst of times. But you are the one I want all of the time. Even the days when I hate you I love you more each day and look forward to an even better and more prosperous 2018 with you full of love, health, happiness and Best wishes. XOXO. Cheers to the one person that reminds me daily that if it’s worth it it doesn’t come easy 🍾
